note: ACORD is a data-standards body, not a regulator. 'acordCitations' and 'sdlcGates' are extension fields for traceability to the SDLC skill and the audit-evidence map; each row corresponds 1:1 to a controls/<id>.control.json definition. Field names follow the Transformation Bridge standards-import.v1 shape; confirm against the live loader before load.

standards.standard: P&C policy messages validate against the ACORD P&C XML schema
standards.whatItMeans: Every outbound and inbound P&C policy message exchanged over the integration platform validates cleanly against the published ACORD P&C XML (XSD) schema, so that carrier and agency partners receive structurally conformant transactions.

standards.standard: ACORD transaction envelopes are well-formed and conformant
standards.whatItMeans: Every ACORD transaction exchanged over the integration platform is wrapped in a well-formed, conformant ACORD transaction envelope, so that routing, correlation, and acknowledgement metadata are reliably interpreted by partner endpoints.

standards.standard: Mandatory ACORD data elements are populated on P&C messages
standards.whatItMeans: Every P&C message carries fully populated values for all data elements that the ACORD P&C Data Standard and Data Dictionary mark as mandatory, so that downstream carriers and analytics consumers receive complete, usable policy data.

standards.standard: Life & Annuity messages conform to ACORD TXLife
standards.whatItMeans: Every Life & Annuity message exchanged over the integration platform validates against the ACORD TXLife standard, so that new-business, in-force, and distribution partners exchange structurally conformant Life & Annuity transactions.

standards.standard: Life OLI_LU code lists are valid and current
standards.whatItMeans: Every coded value carried on a Life & Annuity message uses a valid OLI_LU code drawn from the current ACORD OLI code list, so that enumerated values are interpreted consistently across carriers, BGAs, and distribution platforms.

standards.standard: Certificates of insurance use the current ACORD 25 form
standards.whatItMeans: Every certificate of liability insurance issued uses the current revision of the standard ACORD 25 form, so that certificate holders, agencies, and carriers exchange legally compliant, up-to-date certificates.

standards.standard: ACORD forms in use are on the current release version
standards.whatItMeans: Every ACORD form rendered, ingested, or filed by the organization is on the current ACORD release version so that downstream carriers, agents, and regulators receive standard-conformant document layouts.

standards.standard: Internal data fields map to the ACORD data dictionary
standards.whatItMeans: Every internal data field that participates in carrier, agency, or regulatory exchange is mapped to a corresponding element in the ACORD data dictionary so that semantics are preserved across the integration estate.

standards.standard: ACORD code lists are version-current across systems
standards.whatItMeans: Every ACORD code list referenced by registered schemas and mapping specifications is pinned to a current ACORD code-list version so that enumerations remain interoperable across systems.

standards.standard: Reinsurance messaging conforms to ACORD GRLC
standards.whatItMeans: Every reinsurance message exchanged with brokers, cedents, and reinsurers conforms to the ACORD Global Reinsurance and Large Commercial (GRLC) standard so that placements, bordereaux, and technical accounts process straight-through.
acordCitations: ACORD Global Reinsurance and Large Commercial (GRLC)

standards.standard: Policy APIs align to the ACORD reference model (ADAPT)
standards.whatItMeans: Every policy API endpoint exposed by the organization aligns to the ACORD reference model and the ACORD ADAPT API patterns so that partners can integrate against standard, predictable insurance entities.

standards.standard: Message schemas are registered and version-pinned
standards.whatItMeans: Every message schema used by policy and partner integrations is registered in the schema registry and pinned to an explicit version so that producers and consumers evolve compatibly.
